게임.x: My younger sibling plays computer games every day.
게임.e: From English 'game'. A PC방 ('PC room') is a gaming café.

기타.x: My older brother plays the guitar very well.
기타.e: From English 'guitar'. Don't mix up with 기타 meaning 'etc., other'.
기타.t: Homonym: Sino-Korean 기타 (其他) means 'others, etc.' 'Play guitar' = 기타를 치다.

가르치다.x: My mother teaches English at school.
가르치다.t: Don't confuse with 가리키다 'to point at' — native speakers mix them up too.

달다.e: 달콤하다 = sweet (cuter-sounding). 달 (moon) is a separate word.
달다.t: ㄹ drops before ㄴ: 단 음식 = sweet food.

속옷.x: I packed underwear and socks in my suitcase.
속옷.t: Pronounced [소곧]; with a particle the ㅅ comes back: 속옷이 [소고시].

따라가다.m: to follow, to go along with; to keep up with
따라가다.ex: 길을 잘 몰라서 앞에 가는 친구를 따라갔어요.
따라가다.x: I didn't know the way well, so I followed my friend ahead of me.

편리하다.m: to be convenient, to be handy
편리하다.x: There's a subway station near my house, so it's convenient.
편리하다.t: Pronounced [펼리하다] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ (liquidization).

마음대로.forms: 마음대로 하세요 = Do as you like; casual: 맘대로
마음대로.m: as one pleases, freely, at will
마음대로.ex: 여기 있는 책은 마음대로 읽어도 돼요.
마음대로.x: You can read the books here as you like.
마음대로.e: 마음 'heart, mind' + 대로 'according to' — 'as your heart says'.

심다.ex: 봄이 되면 마당에 꽃을 심을 거예요.
심다.x: When spring comes, I'm going to plant flowers in the yard.
심다.e: Native verb. Proverb: 콩 심은 데 콩 나고 팥 심은 데 팥 난다 'where you plant beans, beans grow' — you reap what you sow.
심다.t: Pronounced [심따]: the ㄷ becomes tense after the stem-final ㅁ. April 5 is 식목일 'Arbor Day', the traditional day for planting trees.

우와.e: A stretched form of 와 'wow', with 우 added for extra excitement.
우와.t: Bright and a little childlike, but adults use it too when genuinely impressed.

설치하다.x: I had internet installed in my new place.
설치하다.e: Literally 'set up and put in place.'
설치하다.t: For apps, 앱을 설치하다 is standard; 앱을 깔다 is the casual version.

오래되다.ex: 우리 집은 아주 오래돼서 겨울에 좀 추워요.
오래되다.x: Our house is very old, so it's a bit cold in winter.
오래되다.e: 오래 'for a long time' + 되다 'to become': something that has existed a long time.

기도하다.x: I prayed to pass the exam.
기도하다.e: Both syllables mean 'pray', doubled for emphasis.
기도하다.t: Prayers often use -게 해 주세요 'please let…': 건강하게 해 주세요.

대조.ex: 두 사람의 성격은 뚜렷한 대조를 이뤄요.
대조.x: The two people's personalities form a clear contrast.
대조.e: Literally 'hold side by side and compare'.

매출.x: Ice cream sales go up a lot in summer.
매출.t: Typical verbs: 매출이 오르다/늘다 'sales rise', 매출이 떨어지다 'sales drop'.

반품.x: The size didn't fit, so I requested a return.

실천.ex: 계획을 세우는 것보다 실천하는 것이 더 중요해요.
실천.x: Putting a plan into action is more important than making it.
실천.t: Common pair: 이론과 실천 'theory and practice'.

연관.ex: 이 두 사건은 서로 연관이 있어요.
연관.x: These two incidents are connected to each other.

치안.ex: 한국은 치안이 좋아서 밤에도 안전한 편이에요.
치안.x: Korea has good public safety, so it's fairly safe even at night.

연대.x: Citizens gathered to stand in solidarity with the victims.
연대.e: Literally 'linked by a belt'; don't confuse with 연대 'era, decade', as in 1990년대.

사설.ex: 오늘 신문 사설은 교육 문제를 다루었어요.
사설.x: Today's newspaper editorial dealt with education issues.
사설.e: Literally 'the company's opinion'; a homonym 사설 means 'private', as in 사설 학원.
사설.t: A 사설 gives the newspaper's own position; a 칼럼 is one writer's personal opinion.

제보.x: The incident became known thanks to a viewer's tip.

어지러움.ex: 갑자기 일어나면 어지러움을 느낄 수 있어요.
어지러움.x: If you stand up suddenly, you may feel dizzy.
어지러움.e: Noun made from 어지럽다 'dizzy' (ㅂ irregular): 어지러우- + -ㅁ.
어지러움.t: In everyday speech people usually just say 어지러워요 'I'm dizzy' instead of the noun.

체벌.ex: 요즘 한국 학교에서는 체벌이 금지되어 있어요.
체벌.x: Corporal punishment is banned in Korean schools these days.

단편.m: short work; short story, short film
단편.ex: 이 작가는 주로 단편 소설을 써요.
단편.x: This author mostly writes short stories.
단편.t: Usually used before a noun: 단편 소설 (short story), 단편 영화 (short film).

소름.ex: 그 가수의 노래를 듣고 소름이 돋았어요.
소름.x: I got goosebumps listening to that singer.
소름.t: 소름 돋다 works for awe or fear; 소름 끼치다 is mostly for fear or disgust.

물러서다.m: to step back; to back down, give in
물러서다.x: It's dangerous, so please take a step back.

간편하다.ex: 이 앱을 쓰면 결제가 아주 간편해요.
간편하다.x: Paying is really easy with this app.

부정확하다.x: Information on the internet is often inaccurate.

서열.ex: 한국 회사에서는 서열이 중요한 경우가 많아요.
서열.x: In Korean companies, rank often matters a lot.
서열.e: Literally 'ordered row': who stands where in line.

의안.x: A new bill was submitted to the National Assembly.
의안.t: 법안 is specifically a bill for a law; 의안 covers any item brought before a legislature.

신념.x: He stood by his convictions to the end.

불의.ex: 그는 불의를 보면 참지 못하는 성격이에요.
불의.x: He's the type who can't stand by when he sees injustice.
불의.t: In 불의의 사고 'unexpected accident', 불의 is a different word meaning 'unforeseen'.

이탈하다.m: to leave, to break away from, to deviate (from a route or group)
이탈하다.x: An accident occurred in which a train left the tracks.
이탈하다.e: Literally 'leave and slip out' of a set line or group.

줄기차게.x: It rained relentlessly all week long.
줄기차게.e: From 줄기 'stream, stem' + 차다 'to be full': a strong, unbroken stream.

애꿎게.m: unfairly, on an innocent party, taking it out on the wrong target
애꿎게.ex: 형한테 혼나고 애꿎게 동생한테 화를 냈어요.
애꿎게.x: After my older brother scolded me, I unfairly took it out on my younger sibling.
애꿎게.e: From 애꿎다 'innocent, undeserving' — used when blame lands on the wrong one.
애꿎게.t: Pronounced [애꾿께]; common pattern: 애꿎은 사람한테 화풀이하다.

자화자찬.ex: 그는 자기 그림을 보며 자화자찬을 늘어놓았어요.
자화자찬.x: He looked at his own painting and went on and on praising it.
자화자찬.e: Literally 'draw it yourself, praise it yourself'.

수면 위로 떠오르다.forms: 수면 위로 떠올라요 · 떠올랐어요 · 떠오를 거예요 (르 irregular); usually 문제가/의혹이 수면 위로 떠오르다
수면 위로 떠오르다.m: to come to the surface, to come to light; to emerge as an issue
수면 위로 떠오르다.ex: 그동안 숨겨져 있던 문제가 수면 위로 떠올랐습니다.
수면 위로 떠오르다.x: Problems that had been hidden all this time have come to light.
수면 위로 떠오르다.e: Literally 'to float up above the water's surface' — like something hidden rising into view.
수면 위로 떠오르다.t: Common in news about scandals or social issues: 의혹이 수면 위로 떠오르다 'suspicions surface'.
rel: to stand out, to be highlighted

기틀.ex: 그는 회사가 성장할 수 있는 기틀을 마련했어요.
기틀.x: He laid the groundwork for the company to grow.
기틀.e: Contains 틀 'frame' — the frame everything else is built on.

탈수.ex: 더운 날에는 탈수를 막으려면 물을 자주 마셔야 해요.
탈수.x: On hot days, you should drink water often to prevent dehydration.
탈수.e: Literally 'remove water' — for the body or a washing machine's spin cycle.

경력 단절.ex: 출산 후에 경력 단절을 겪는 여성이 많습니다.
경력 단절.x: Many women experience a career break after giving birth.
경력 단절.e: Literally 'career cut off' — usually about women leaving work for childcare.

예시하다.m: to give an example, to illustrate
예시하다.ex: 선생님은 새로운 문법을 여러 문장으로 예시해 주셨어요.
예시하다.x: The teacher illustrated the new grammar with several sentences.
예시하다.t: In everyday speech, 예를 들다 is far more common; 예시하다 sounds written and formal.

회부하다.m: to refer (to a court or committee), to submit
회부하다.x: The prosecution brought him to trial.
회부하다.e: Literally 'send around and attach' — passing a case to another body.
회부하다.t: The passive 회부되다 is very common in news: 재판에 회부되다, 'to be put on trial.'

훈수.m: unsolicited advice (orig. from a game onlooker), kibitzing
훈수.x: Please stop giving me advice from the sidelines.
훈수.e: Literally 'teaching moves': an onlooker telling players what to play in baduk or janggi.
훈수.t: The verb is 두다 or 하다: 훈수(를) 두다; it often sounds annoying, like backseat driving.

점유.ex: 그는 그 땅을 20년 동안 점유해 왔습니다.
점유.x: He has occupied that land for 20 years.
점유.e: Literally 'occupy and have' — physical control, not necessarily ownership.
점유.t: 점유 is actual possession, 소유 is legal ownership, and 시장 점유율 means 'market share'.

세율.x: The government raised the income tax rate by 2 percent.
세율.t: The 'rate' syllable is 율 after a vowel or ㄴ (세율, 비율) and 률 elsewhere (확률, 성공률).

타결.ex: 오랜 논의 끝에 무역 협상이 마침내 타결되었습니다.
타결.x: After long discussions, the trade negotiations were finally concluded.
타결.t: Opposite of 결렬; news often says 협상이 타결되다 versus 협상이 결렬되다.

관조.ex: 노년의 시인은 삶을 담담하게 관조하는 시를 썼어요.
관조.x: In old age, the poet wrote poems calmly contemplating life.
관조.e: Literally 'view and illuminate': quiet, detached gazing.

평면적 인물.ex: 동화 속 악당은 처음부터 끝까지 변하지 않는 평면적 인물이에요.
평면적 인물.x: Villains in fairy tales are flat characters who never change from start to finish.
평면적 인물.e: Literally 'flat-surface person' — a character whose personality never changes.

음계.ex: 한국 전통 음악은 주로 다섯 개의 음으로 된 음계를 사용합니다.
음계.x: Korean traditional music mainly uses a scale made of five notes.
음계.e: Literally 'sound steps', like a staircase of notes.

저해하다.m: to hinder, to impede, to hamper
저해하다.ex: 지나친 규제는 경제 성장을 저해할 수 있습니다.
저해하다.x: Excessive regulation can hinder economic growth.

대거.m: in large numbers, en masse, on a large scale
대거.ex: 이번 축제에 젊은 관객들이 대거 몰렸습니다.
대거.x: Young audiences flocked to this festival in large numbers.
대거.e: Literally 'a big move': moving all at once, in force.

면탈하다.m: to evade, to escape (duty or responsibility)
면탈하다.x: He was caught trying to evade military service.
면탈하다.e: Literally 'escape and slip out of' an obligation.
면탈하다.t: Almost always in 병역 면탈 or 책임 면탈 — legal and news language.

연착륙하다.m: to make a soft landing (also of an economy)
연착륙하다.ex: 정부는 부동산 시장이 연착륙하기를 기대하고 있습니다.
연착륙하다.x: The government hopes the housing market will make a soft landing.
연착륙하다.e: Literally 'soft land-touching'; also used for economies cooling without a crash.

천거하다.ex: 스승은 가장 뛰어난 제자를 왕에게 천거했습니다.
천거하다.x: The teacher recommended his most outstanding disciple to the king.
천거하다.e: Literally 'recommend and raise up' — putting a person forward for office.

혐오하다.m: to loathe, to detest, to abhor
혐오하다.x: He detests violence more than anything.
혐오하다.e: Literally 'dislike and hate' — strong, visceral aversion.
혐오하다.t: 혐오 시설 means facilities people don't want nearby, like landfills — a NIMBY term.

한산하다.ex: 평일 오전이라서 그런지 백화점이 아주 한산해요.
한산하다.x: Maybe because it's a weekday morning, the department store is very quiet.
한산하다.t: Describes places with few people: 거리가 한산하다, 도로가 한산하다.

귀결.ex: 그런 행동은 결국 실패로 귀결될 거예요.
귀결.x: That kind of behavior will end in failure.
귀결.e: Literally 'returning to a conclusion': where things end up.
귀결.t: Pattern: N(으)로 귀결되다, 'to end up in N.'
